description: Save the verified reusable workflow after discovering or completing a browser task. Store durable UI labels, decisions, and pitfalls; do not store passwords, one-time codes, or transient [ref=eN] handles.

confidence.description: Confidence that the workflow is reusable.

notes.description: Short extra context for future agents.

outcome.description: What succeeded or what state was reached.

pitfalls.description: Things that were wrong, surprising, changed, or easy to miss.

selectors.description: Durable UI cues: visible labels, section names, field names. Avoid transient refs.

site.description: Human site name, e.g. 'Google Play Console'.

steps.description: Ordered durable steps that worked. Use visible labels and page names, not transient refs.

supersedes.description: Workflow memory ids this record replaces because they are stale or incomplete.

task.description: Reusable task objective, e.g. 'Create a new Android app in Google Play Console'.

title.description: Page title where the workflow starts or was verified.

name: browser_workflow_remember
